annotation.title_en: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy: An Institutional Step in Governing New Technology
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ (Ministry of Science and Technology), Trung tâm Truyền thông KH&CN
annotation.venue: Cổng thông tin điện tử Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ (mst.gov.vn)
annotation.summary_en: Ministry of Science and Technology news article explaining that Vietnam's draft AI Law embeds the National AI Strategy in legislation. It covers sovereign foundation models, AI infrastructure, human resources, public-private partnership, international norm-shaping and the Ministry's role. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Draft AI Law enshrines the National AI Strategy, issued by the Prime Minister and reviewed every three years
Priority on Vietnamese foundation models and LLMs trained on Vietnamese data for data sovereignty
Build national AI infrastructure: computing, data centres, open data
MST publishes a priority AI technology list and guides ministries and localities
Public-private partnership and active participation in global AI governance norms
